content.text: Match Preview PSG Starting Lineup Against Liverpool Revealed By Ed - 14 April 2026, 20:08 Carl Recine/Getty Images FacebookWhatsAppTwitterRedditEmailShare Paris Saint-Germain will look to advance to the semi-final of the UEFA Champions League as they travel to Anfield to take on Liverpool FC.Coming into the match, PSG has a 2-0 advantage after defeating the Premier League side last week at the Parc des Princes. Knowing at least a draw will see PSG reach the next round, Luis Enrique didn’t take any chances with his starting lineup.Enrique expects struggling Nantes to pose sterner test than OLKeep WatchingNext video in 10 secondsMore Videos0 seconds of 30 secondsVolume 0%Press shift question mark to access a list of keyboard shortcutsKeyboard ShortcutsEnabledDisabledShortcuts Open/Close/ or ?Play/PauseSPACEIncrease Volume↑Decrease Volume↓Seek Forward→Seek Backward←Captions On/OffcFullscreen/Exit FullscreenfMute/UnmutemDecrease Caption Size-Increase Caption Size+ or =Seek %0-9 Next UpPSG train ahead of weekend clash with Lyon01:02 This ad will end in 24Live00:0500:2400:30 In goal is Matvey Safonov and in defense, Nuno Mendes, Willian Pacho, Marquinhos, and Achraf Hakimi. In the midfield, João Neves, Vitinha, and Warren Zaïre-Emery will look to control the game. Fabian Ruiz continues to miss time due to injury. In the attack, Bradley Barcola is back from injury, but Khvicha Kvaratskhelia, Ousmane Dembélé, and Désiré Doué get the nod. It’s the same starting lineup that Luis Enrique went with last week.PSG haven’t played a match since the 2-0 win over Liverpool, and there could be some rust. I anticipate PSG will look to dominate possession and hit on the counter as the Reds press forward, knowing they need to score goals. One big absence from Arne Slot’s starting lineup is Mohamed Salah, who will start on the bench.
